[23] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ EN: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
[12] AR: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ EN: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

[23] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ EN: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

folded.id: and david|became|certain that we had tried him
folded.subject: And David
folded.object: certain that We had tried him

spans.text: And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

folded.id: as it|will|lead you astray from the way of allah
folded.subject: as it
folded.object: lead you astray from the way of Allah

spans.text: [26] AR: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ EN: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah."

folded.id: asked forgiveness|of|his lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to allah]
folded.subject: asked forgiveness
folded.object: his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah]

spans.text: And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

folded.id: before him|in|the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses
folded.subject: before him

spans.text: [31] AR: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ EN: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

folded.id: blessed book|which|we have revealed to you
folded.subject: blessed Book

spans.text: [29] AR: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ EN: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
[30] AR: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ EN: And to David We gave Solomon.
[2] AR: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ EN: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
[14] AR: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ EN: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

[18] AR: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ EN: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
[8] AR: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ EN: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?"

folded.id: his kingdom|and|gave him wisdom and discernment in speech
folded.subject: his kingdom
folded.object: gave him wisdom and discernment in speech

spans.text: [20] AR: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ EN: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

folded.id: i|gave|preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]
folded.subject: I
folded.object: preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]

spans.text: [32] AR: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ EN: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
[15] AR: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ EN: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

folded.id: its verses|and|that those of understanding would be reminded
folded.subject: its verses
folded.object: that those of understanding would be reminded

spans.text: [29] AR: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ EN: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

folded.id: not heard|of|this in the latest religion
folded.subject: not heard

spans.text: [7] AR: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ EN: We have not heard of this in the latest religion.
[We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

folded.id: thamud|and|the people of lot and the companions of the thicket
folded.subject: Thamud
folded.object: the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket

spans.text: [13] AR: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ EN: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket.
That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
[16] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ EN: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"

folded.id: the depositories|of|the mercy of your lord
folded.subject: the depositories

spans.text: [9] AR: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ EN: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

folded.id: the dominion|of|the heavens and the earth and what is between them?
folded.subject: the dominion
folded.object: the heavens and the earth and what is between them?

spans.text: [10] AR: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ EN: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them?
[9] AR: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ EN: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

folded.id: the heaven|and|the earth and that between them aimlessly
folded.subject: the heaven
folded.object: the earth and that between them aimlessly

spans.text: [27] AR: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ EN: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly.
[21] AR: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ EN: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
[12] AR: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ EN: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

folded.id: the people|in|truth and do not follow [your own] desire
folded.subject: the people
folded.object: truth and do not follow [your own] desire

spans.text: [26] AR: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ EN: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah."
[12] AR: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ EN: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

[17] AR: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ EN: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
By the Qur'an containing reminder...
[21] AR: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ EN: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

folded.id: the way|of|allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the day of account
folded.subject: the way
folded.object: Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account

spans.text: Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
Rather, they are in doubt about My message.

[17] AR: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ EN: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].

folded.id: to us|and|a good place of return
folded.subject: to Us

spans.text: [25] AR: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ EN: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

folded.id: upon david|and|he was alarmed by them?
folded.subject: upon David

spans.text: [22] AR: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ EN: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them?
Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

folded.id: who believe|and|do righteous deeds - and few are they
folded.subject: who believe
folded.object: do righteous deeds - and few are they

spans.text: And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they."

[28] AR: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ EN: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land?

folded.id: who|will|be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]
folded.subject: who
folded.object: be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]

spans.text: [11] AR: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ EN: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

folded.id: with truth|and|do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path
folded.subject: with truth
folded.object: do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path

spans.text: [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

folded.id: wronged you|in|demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes
folded.subject: wronged you
folded.object: demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes

spans.text: [24] AR: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩ EN: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes.
